groups.label: Elo rating
groups.desc: Margin-adjusted team Elo difference, including home court.

groups.label: Efficiency form
groups.desc: Recent offensive, defensive and net rating per 100 possessions, and win rate (10-game half-life).

groups.label: Four factors
groups.desc: Shooting (and shooting allowed), turnovers, offensive rebounding, free throws.

groups.label: Rest & schedule
groups.desc: Days of rest, back-to-backs, games played this season.

groups.label: Players: PIE
groups.desc: Available rotation's minutes-weighted share of box-score events.

groups.label: Players: on-court net rating
groups.desc: Available rotation's plus-minus per 100 possessions on the floor.

groups.label: Players: Game Score/36
groups.desc: Available rotation's box-score production per 36 minutes.

groups.label: Players: best available
groups.desc: Highest-rated available player expected to play 20+ minutes.

groups.label: Players: RAPM (lineup data)
groups.desc: Adjusted plus-minus from play-by-play lineups: each player's impact holding the other nine fixed (ridge, monthly walk-forward fits).

groups.label: Players: rotation minutes
groups.desc: Expected minutes of the top 10 available players (missing-player load).

groups.label: Pace (tempo)
groups.desc: Difference in recent possessions per game. Off by default: tempo says little about who wins.

groups.label: Players: Tipoff Impact (custom)
groups.desc: Our own BPM-style metric: box-score rates per 100 possessions regressed onto on-court plus-minus, fit on 2010-12 only.

groups.label: Massey ratings
groups.desc: Opponent-adjusted team ratings: recency-weighted ridge regression of every margin on team indicators.

groups.label: Travel & schedule density
groups.desc: Distance since the last game, time-zone shift, 3-in-4 nights, games in 7 days, Denver/Utah altitude.
